title: About ShopWave
subtitle: A modern e-commerce platform built for speed, simplicity, and trust.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: We set out to make online shopping feel effortless. ShopWave curates premium products across electronics, fashion, home, and more — all in one place, with transparent pricing and fast delivery.

story.title: Our story
story.body: ShopWave was founded with a simple belief: shopping should be enjoyable, not stressful. We started with a small catalog and big ambitions. Today we serve tens of thousands of happy customers and continue to grow every day.

items.title: Quality first
items.description: Every product is hand-picked and held to a high standard before it reaches our shelves.

items.title: Customer focus
items.description: Your satisfaction is the measure of our success. We back every purchase with our 30-day return guarantee.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: No hidden fees, no dark patterns. What you see is what you pay.

items.title: Sustainability
items.description: We partner with suppliers who share our commitment to responsible sourcing and packaging.

team.title: Built by a passionate team
team.body: Behind ShopWave is a small, dedicated team of designers, engineers, and e-commerce enthusiasts who care deeply about the products they ship.
